DIVINER-DESTINY.title: Destiny
DIVINER-DESTINY.DESCRIPTION: A persistent run value from zero to five. Zero is Doomed, one or two are Bad Omen, three or four are Good Omen, and five is Revelation. If you would lose Destiny while at zero, lose 1 Countdown of Destiny instead.

DIVINER-BAD_OMEN.title: Bad Omen
DIVINER-BAD_OMEN.DESCRIPTION: You are at zero, one, or two Destiny. Some Diviner cards have different effects during Bad Omen.

DIVINER-GOOD_OMEN.title: Good Omen

DIVINER-DIVINATE.title: Divinate
DIVINER-DIVINATE.DESCRIPTION: Record a future forecast in your Crystal Ball. Some Diviner effects care about recorded Divinations.

DIVINER-FORETELL.title: Foretell
DIVINER-FORETELL.DESCRIPTION: Queue the listed effect to resolve at the start of your next turn. Multiple Foretell effects queue separately.
DIVINER-FORETELL.description: Queue the listed effect to resolve at the start of your next turn. Multiple Foretell effects queue separately.
DIVINER-DREDGE.title: Doomed
DIVINER-DREDGE.DESCRIPTION: The first time each combat your Destiny reaches 0, gain Countdown of Destiny and shuffle Escape from Destiny cards into your draw pile. If you would lose Destiny while at 0, lose 1 Countdown of Destiny instead.

DIVINER-ENLIGHTENMENT.title: Revelation
DIVINER-ENLIGHTENMENT.DESCRIPTION: At 5 Destiny, start combat by searching for 3 cards and putting them into your hand, then lose 1 Destiny. When a card's Revelation effect triggers, lose 1 Destiny.

DIVINER-FATED.title: Fated
DIVINER-FATED.DESCRIPTION: A Fated card costs 0 this turn. Its base cost is unchanged.

DIVINER-COUNTDOWN_OF_DESTINY.title: Countdown of Destiny
DIVINER-COUNTDOWN_OF_DESTINY.DESCRIPTION: Doomed countdown. Lose 1 at end of turn. When it reaches 0, you are defeated.

DIVINER-SCRY.title: Scry
DIVINER-SCRY.DESCRIPTION: Look at the top X cards of your draw pile. Discard any number of them.
